**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at `internal/filter/` (entry `filter.DefaultEngine()` — `internal/filter/engine.go:111`; docs `internal/filter/README.md`). Mechanism: CEL text is compiled against the memo schema (`schema.go`), normalized into a dialect-agnostic IR (`parser.go`/`ir.go`), then rendered to a SQL fragment plus args for the target dialect by `render.go`, which each driver invokes via `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres, ...)` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`. The API validates the expression first in `APIV1Service.validateFilter` (`server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:336`, called from `memo_service.go:207`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React bundle is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:40-59` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); wired at `server/server.go:70` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — one immediate RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker loop (server/server.go:150-166; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-45)
```
That is the only background runner started. Unused-infra note: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron scheduler with parser/middleware, `internal/scheduler/README.md`) is **not** used by the server — its only importers are its own `example_test.go` and `integration_test.go`. Also, `server/runner/memopayload` is a helper package, not a scheduled runner (called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172` (installed on the Connect transport at `:177`), with token storage/refresh in `web/src/auth-state.ts` and proactive refresh in `web/src/hooks/useTokenRefreshOnFocus.ts`. Tokens managed: short-lived JWT **access token** (Bearer header, localStorage/in-memory, cross-tab BroadcastChannel sync) and the long-lived **refresh token** held in the `memos_refresh` httpOnly cookie (sent via `credentials: "include"`, refreshed through `AuthService.RefreshToken`); the backend additionally accepts **personal access tokens** as bearer tokens. Backend validation: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`, `extract.go`), invoked through `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` and `connect_interceptors.go` (wired in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66,134-138`).
